title: Discord bot gets temporarily blocked by Cloudflare after a loop of 401, 403 or 429 responses
symptoms: Every request fails for a while, including to unrelated routes
Error pages from Cloudflare instead of JSON from Discord
Block starts after a bug kept retrying a deleted webhook or a missing permission
cause: More than 10,000 invalid requests (401, 403 or 429) in 10 minutes triggers a temporary IP restriction. Shared-scope 429s do not count, but retry loops on bad tokens, missing permissions or 404 webhooks do.
fix: Stop calling a webhook after a 404, check permissions before calling, and back off on 429 using retry_after and the X-RateLimit-Scope header instead of retrying at once.
affected: Discord REST API, all bots and webhooks, as of 2026-10
